en-US.description: AI-assisted low-code platform for building desktop, web, and mobile applications
en-US.longDescription: Lianja is an AI-assisted low-code application development platform for building and deploying desktop, web, mobile, and progressive web applications. It supports no-code, low-code, and professional development workflows using LianjaScript/Visual FoxPro, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, and can be used to modernise legacy Visual FoxPro (VFP) applications.
en-US.name: Lianja App Builder
